pool.text: English forces under the Earl of Arundel destroyed the harbour at Roscoff.
Mary, Queen of Scots, disembarked at Roscoff en route from Scotland.
The town of Roscoff was raised to an independent commune.
Louis-Eugène Bagot opened the Institut Marin in Roscoff.
The Perharidy Centre heliomarin hospital was founded by the sea.
The illustrator Henry Gerbault and his wife moved to live in Roscoff.
The French government agreed to provide a deep-water port at Roscoff.
Primary-school children attended bilingual schools in the municipality.
The municipality launched a language plan through Ya d'ar brezhoneg.
Roscoff received the petite cité de caractère de Bretagne label.
